_comment: Game feel tuning. Hit-stop times are in real seconds; the game runs at timeScale while frozen.

walk._comment: Player procedural walk. stride = radians of leg cycle per metre; swings in radians (legs) and metres (arms, bob, breath); lean in radians at full sprint.

glow._comment: Soft light around the hero in the dark (night, Shadow, dungeons).

camera._comment: lockTurn: how fast the camera swings to a locked target (per second).
